items.question: How do I create an account?
items.answer: You can create an account by tapping the 'Sign Up' button on the login screen. Fill in your name, email, and password, then tap 'Create Account' to get started.

items.question: How do I reset my password?
items.answer: On the login screen, tap 'Forgot Password', enter your email address, and we'll send you a reset link. Click the link in the email to create a new password.

items.question: How do I update my profile information?
items.answer: Go to Profile > tap on your profile picture or name > Edit Profile. You can update your name, email, phone number, and profile picture from there.

items.question: Can I change my email address?
items.answer: Yes, you can change your email in Edit Profile. You'll need to verify the new email address before the change takes effect.

items.question: How do I track my order?
items.answer: You can track your order from Profile > Track Order or by going to My Orders and selecting the order you want to track. You'll see real-time updates on your order status.

items.question: How long does shipping take?
items.answer: Standard shipping typically takes 3-7 business days. Express shipping takes 1-3 business days. Actual delivery times may vary based on your location.

items.question: Can I cancel my order?
items.answer: Yes, you can cancel your order before it ships. Go to My Orders, select the order, and tap 'Cancel Order'. Once shipped, you'll need to request a return instead.

items.question: How do I return an item?
items.answer: Go to My Orders, select the completed order, and tap 'Request Return'. Follow the instructions to initiate the return process. Items must be returned within 30 days of delivery.

items.question: What if my order arrives damaged?
items.answer: If your order arrives damaged, please contact customer support immediately with photos of the damage. We'll arrange a replacement or refund as appropriate.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), debit cards, PayPal, and other digital payment methods depending on your region.

items.question: Is it safe to use my credit card?
items.answer: Yes, we use industry-standard SSL encryption to protect your payment information. We never store your complete credit card details on our servers.

items.question: Can I save my payment information?
items.answer: Yes, you can securely save your payment methods in your account for faster checkout. Your information is encrypted and stored securely.

items.question: When will I be charged?
items.answer: Your payment method will be charged when you place your order. For pre-orders, you'll be charged when the item ships.

items.question: How do refunds work?
items.answer: Refunds are processed to your original payment method within 5-10 business days after we receive your return. You'll receive an email confirmation once the refund is processed.

items.question: Do you ship internationally?
items.answer: Yes, we ship to many countries worldwide. Shipping costs and delivery times vary by destination. Check the checkout page for specific details for your location.

items.question: How much does shipping cost?
items.answer: Shipping costs depend on your location, order size, and shipping speed. Free shipping is available on orders over a certain amount (varies by region).

items.question: Can I change my shipping address?
items.answer: You can change your shipping address before the order ships. Go to My Orders, select the order, and tap 'Change Address'. After shipping, contact customer support for assistance.

items.question: What if I'm not home when my order arrives?
items.answer: The delivery carrier will leave a notice with instructions on how to reschedule delivery or pick up your package from a local facility.

items.question: How do I know if a product is in stock?
items.answer: Product availability is shown on each product page. If an item is out of stock, you can tap 'Notify Me' to receive an alert when it's back in stock.

items.question: Can I reserve a product?
items.answer: We don't offer product reservations, but you can add items to your wishlist to save them for later. Popular items may sell out quickly.

items.question: Are product reviews verified?
items.answer: Yes, reviews are only allowed from customers who have purchased the product. This ensures authentic feedback from real buyers.

items.question: How do I compare products?
items.answer: Tap the compare icon on product listings to add items to your comparison list. Then go to Compare (from your profile menu) to see them side-by-side.

items.question: How do I enable notifications?
items.answer: Go to your device Settings > Apps > MartFury > Notifications and enable notifications. You can customize notification preferences in the app settings.

items.question: Can I use the app offline?
items.answer: Some features like viewing your wishlist and saved addresses work offline. However, browsing products and placing orders requires an internet connection.

items.question: How do I change the app language?
items.answer: Go to Profile > tap on the current language > select your preferred language. The app will restart to apply the new language.

items.question: How do I switch between light and dark mode?
items.answer: Go to Profile > tap on Theme > select Light, Dark, or System. The app theme will change immediately.

items.question: Can I use biometric login?
items.answer: Yes, if you're logged in, go to Settings > Security and enable Face ID or Touch ID. Your device must support biometric authentication.

items.question: How do I contact customer support?
items.answer: You can reach our support team through Profile > Customer Service. We're available 24/7 via chat, email, or phone.

items.question: What are your business hours?
items.answer: Our customer support is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week to assist you with any questions or concerns.

items.question: How long does it take to get a response?
items.answer: We typically respond to inquiries within 24 hours. For urgent matters, please use our live chat for immediate assistance.

items.question: Can I schedule a callback?
items.answer: Yes, when you contact customer support, you can request a callback at a time that's convenient for you.
